name: Options and Payoffs
description: Draw option payoffs, combine them into strategies, and derive put-call parity.

requires.why: Option payoffs use share prices and the vocabulary of trading shares.
Draws payoffs as piecewise functions and shifts graphs to turn payoffs into profit diagrams.
Uses the forward price from cost of carry and short sales to derive put-call parity and bounds.

lessonObjectives.l1-right-to-buy: Draw a call option’s payoff at expiry.
lessonObjectives.l2-right-to-sell: Draw a put option’s payoff at expiry.
lessonObjectives.l3-payoff-minus-premium: Draw a profit diagram and find the break-even price.
lessonObjectives.l4-buying-or-writing: Compare long and short option positions and their risks.
lessonObjectives.l5-spreads: Build a spread from two strikes and read its capped payoff.
lessonObjectives.l6-straddles: Build straddles and strangles that profit from a large move either way.
lessonObjectives.l7-butterfly: Build a butterfly from three strikes.
lessonObjectives.l8-with-the-stock: Combine options with the stock and match each to a view.
lessonObjectives.l9-put-call-parity: Derive put-call parity from two portfolios with equal payoffs.
lessonObjectives.l10-bounds: Derive no-arbitrage bounds on call and put prices.
lessonObjectives.l11-exercise-early: Show why exercising an American call on a stock with no dividends never pays.
lessonObjectives.l12-how-price-responds: Read delta, gamma, vega and theta from how an option’s price curve moves.
